terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses Gradix: instructors, students, administrators and guests in live sessions.

s1.title: Accounts
s1.body: Keep your password private. You are responsible for what happens in your account. Guests may take part only in live sessions.

s2.title: Your material
s2.body: Instructors must hold the rights to the material they upload or link (or be allowed to use it for teaching). Gradix uses it only to prepare your assessments and does not sell it.

s3.title: AI-generated questions
s3.body: Questions, objectives and study plans are written by AI from your material and checked automatically. Instructors remain responsible for reviewing what they publish.

s4.title: Fair use
s4.body: Do not try to see answers before they are revealed, take another person's exam, or disrupt the service.

s5.title: Proctoring
s5.body: When an instructor turns on proctoring, Gradix records only the events described in the Privacy Policy and shows them to that instructor.

s6.title: Plans
s6.body: Plans and their limits are shown on the home page. Limits never stop an exam that is already running.

s7.title: Availability
s7.body: Gradix is provided as is during the pilot. We aim to keep it available and to keep your data safe, but cannot promise uninterrupted service.

s8.title: Contact
s8.body: Questions about these terms: use the contact form on the home page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what Gradix stores, why, and who can see it.

s1.title: What we store
s1.body: Your name, email, role, language and, for students, answers, scores and results. Instructors' uploaded files and the questions made from them.

s2.title: Who sees it
s2.body: Students see their own results. Instructors see the results of their own assessments. Administrators see the members of their groups. Nobody else.

s3.title: Proctoring records
s3.body: Only when the instructor turns proctoring on: leaving the exam tab or window, leaving fullscreen, and copy/paste/right-click attempts, each with its time. No camera, microphone or screen recording, ever.

s4.title: AI providers
s4.body: To write questions, Gradix sends passages of the instructor's material to Google Gemini or Groq. Student answers and personal data are not sent.

s5.title: Files
s5.body: Files are stored privately (Cloudflare R2) and opened only through links that expire after a few minutes.

s6.title: Live sessions
s6.body: Guests give only a nickname. Session results are kept for the teacher.

s7.title: Deleting your account
s7.body: When an account is deleted its personal data is removed; results stay only in anonymous form for the instructor's statistics.

s8.title: Security
s8.body: Passwords are hashed, connections are encrypted, and access is checked on every request.

s9.title: Contact
s9.body: Questions or requests about your data: use the contact form on the home page.
